signature.name: VTask.idealOfSet
signature.type: {X : Type u_1} -> (R : Type u_2) -> [TopologicalSpace X] -> [Semiring R] -> [TopologicalSpace R] -> [IsTopologicalSemiring R] -> (s : Set X) -> Ideal C(X, R)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total with no junk-value inputs; it is well-defined for all subsets s of X, including the empty set and the full set, with mathematically natural behavior at both extremes.

facts.statement: ∀ (X : Type*) (R : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R] (s : Set X), (0 : ContinuousMap X R) ∈ VTask.idealOfSet R s

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (X : Type*) (R : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R], VTask.idealOfSet R (Set.univ : Set X) = ⊤

facts.statement: ∀ (X : Type*) (R : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R] (s₁ s₂ : Set X), s₁ ⊆ s₂ → VTask.idealOfSet R s₁ ≤ VTask.idealOfSet R s₂

facts.statement: ∀ (X : Type*) (R : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R] (s t : Set X), VTask.idealOfSet R (s ∩ t) ≤ VTask.idealOfSet R s

facts.statement: ∀ (X : Type*) (R : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R] (s t : Set X), VTask.idealOfSet R s ≤ VTask.idealOfSet R (s ∪ t)
